frozen_settings.D_budget_scope: Per-target input count matched;global union,correlation,search cost not matched
frozen_settings.numerical_failure: Stop on PLS fitting warnings,nonfinite values or isolation/identity failure;no score-driven retry

aggregation: Compute metrics from each seed full evaluation set; Corn pools 80 OOF rows before scoring. Average metrics across the specified seeds, then across ten D workflows. SD is sample SD (ddof=1) across the ten workflow macro-R2 values after seed aggregation. Relative RMSE is a ratio of aggregated RMSE values.
